lines.zh: 长腿一步一步踩过草丛
lines.en: My long legs stride through the grass
I hold my head above the grass
My claws come down and flatten the grass
I walk as if measuring the ground

lines.zh: 脖子前伸，眼睛扫着四周
lines.en: Neck forward, I sweep my eyes around
One step clears half a dirt pit
I trot along the plains

lines.zh: 尾巴短短的，稳住了方向
lines.en: My short tail keeps me steady
I change direction in the tall grass
Wind lifts the feathers on my neck
I stand still, my head like an axe
I peck at the ground

lines.zh: 远处的羊群让我盯着看了很久
lines.en: I stare a long while at distant sheep
My beak hangs slightly open

lines.zh: 阳光让我眼里的东西更清楚
lines.en: Sunlight sharpens what I see
I shake out all my feathers

lines.zh: 我抬脚试探，又轻轻落回
lines.en: I lift a foot, test it, and set it back

lines.zh: 平原上没有比我更高的影子。
lines.en: No shadow on these plains stands taller than mine.
I don't call; I just stand
I turn my neck slowly

lines.zh: 这个平原空旷得让人不安
lines.en: This plain is uncomfortably open
I hear footsteps from very far
I tip my head to one side

lines.zh: 我啄了一下自己的胸口
lines.en: I peck at my own chest
The wind stops and so do I
I wait for the grass to give something away

lines.zh: 你站在那儿，我已经看着你了
lines.en: You stand there and I'm already watching

lines.zh: 我的头歪了一下，又正回来
lines.en: My head tilts and snaps level again
You're not much shorter than me
I take one step toward you, then another

lines.zh: 我的喙适合撕，不适合说
lines.en: This beak is made for tearing, not talking
You put your back to a tree; smart
I hear your breathing
We're not acquainted; don't come much closer

lines.zh: 这片平原上，你太显眼了
lines.en: On this plain you stand out too much
No hurry; you can't outrun me

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住了你的鞋
lines.en: My shadow covers your boots
I moved while you blinked
I shriek and spring away
My feathers puff out

lines.zh: 我退了两步，脖子缩回来
lines.en: I back off two steps, neck drawn in
This leg won't push properly
I clack and my voice shakes

lines.zh: 我低头瞧了瞧那道口子
lines.en: I look down at the gash
I circle instead of charging

lines.zh: 我抖了抖被撞歪的羽毛
lines.en: I shake my rumpled feathers
Blood on the grass is very visible
Panting, I still keep my eyes on you
Put that meat down, then step away

lines.zh: 生肉的味道让我脖子发紧
lines.en: The smell of raw meat tightens my neck
What you're holding is too small
I lower my head toward your hand
Stop waving it; my eyes blur

lines.zh: 我一口吞下去，几乎没嚼
lines.en: I swallow it in one go, barely chewing
Any more? I wouldn't mind

lines.zh: 你的手指差点也被叼住
lines.en: Your fingers were almost caught too
I eat first, then I look at you
This one's still bloody; just right

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，我晃了一下
lines.en: You hit my leg and I sway
I shove you aside with my chest

lines.zh: 你的肩甲磕在我胸骨上
lines.en: Your shoulder plate knocks my breastbone

lines.zh: 我们撞得草叶都飞起来
lines.en: We collide and grass blades fly

lines.zh: 别挡我的路，我停不下来
lines.en: Don't block me; I can't stop easily

lines.zh: 这一撞把我撞偏了半步
lines.en: The impact knocks me half a step off line

lines.zh: 我的爪子踩到了你的脚边
lines.en: My claws land right beside your feet
You pull back between my legs
The bump leaves us both startled
I shake the feathers you ruffled

lines.zh: 远处有一声短促的回应
lines.en: A short answer comes from far off
We dip our heads at each other
I run half a circle around her

lines.zh: 我叼来一根草茎放在她脚边
lines.en: I lay a grass stalk at her feet

lines.zh: 她的颈羽立起来，又落下
lines.en: Her neck feathers rise and settle

lines.zh: 我们一起朝草丛深处走
lines.en: We walk together into the deep grass

lines.zh: 我在空地上刨开一片土
lines.en: I scrape a patch of earth clear

lines.zh: 我们的步子慢慢对上了
lines.en: Our steps fall into the same rhythm
She calls and I answer

lines.zh: 这片猎场以后两个人用
lines.en: This hunting ground serves two now
I scoop it up and give it a shake
I can't bite through this

lines.zh: 我用一只爪子把它扣住
lines.en: I clamp it under one claw
It's far bigger than a bug

lines.zh: 我叼着它走了两步，又放下
lines.en: I carry it two steps and drop it

lines.zh: 它在我的爪间滚了出去
lines.en: It rolls out from between my claws
I grind it into the dirt underfoot
This thing tastes strange
I'll keep it; might be useful
I toss it out of the grass

lines.zh: 你跑起来的那一刻，我就追了
lines.en: The moment you ran, I gave chase

lines.zh: 我锁定你了，别装作没看见
lines.en: I've locked on; don't pretend otherwise
The grass is too short to hide you
I drop my neck and lengthen my stride
Your scent is fresh

lines.zh: 我张开喙，发出咔的一声
lines.en: I open my beak with a clack
I know this ground; you won't escape
My claws dig into the soil

lines.zh: 你一转身，我就知道你要跑
lines.en: You turned and I knew you'd run
Prey always has the same look in its eyes
I don't call; I save the breath
The wind blows my way; perfect
I take the shortest line
You're mine now

lines.zh: 我跟着你，步幅一点没乱
lines.en: I follow, my stride unbroken
You break left and I cut you off

lines.zh: 我始终保持两三个身位
lines.en: I hold two or three lengths behind

lines.zh: 你的喘息已经盖过我的脚步
lines.en: Your gasping now drowns out my own steps
The grass doesn't block my sight
I wait for you to trip yourself

lines.zh: 我的脖子一直对着你的方向
lines.en: My neck stays aimed your way

lines.zh: 你回头看，我就多跑两步
lines.en: You look back and I gain two steps
There's no cover on this plain

lines.zh: 我的脚落地几乎没有声音
lines.en: My feet land almost silently
You change direction and so do I
Don't climb; I can reach
My eyes stay on the back of your neck

lines.zh: 你越跑越慢，我越跑越稳
lines.en: You slow down; I settle into pace

lines.zh: 距离在缩短，你听得出来
lines.en: The gap is closing; you can hear it
I save my strength and wait for you to break

lines.zh: 我的喙往前一啄，像锤子
lines.en: My beak hammers forward
This kick goes for your ribs

lines.zh: 我一跃而起，爪尖先撞上你
lines.en: I leap, and my claw tips land on you first

lines.zh: 你挡了，手臂被震得发麻
lines.en: You block and your arm goes numb
I bite and wrench backward
My claw tips open your leg

lines.zh: 这一下踩在你脚边，土都陷了
lines.en: My foot lands beside you and the dirt sinks
My beak rings against your helmet

lines.zh: 你滚开了，草被踩得乱七八糟
lines.en: You roll clear and the grass is wrecked

lines.zh: 我用脖子甩出一记横击
lines.en: I whip my neck in a sideways blow
I miss and it angers me

lines.zh: 你退得太快，我只抓到衣角
lines.en: You retreat too fast; I only catch cloth

lines.zh: 血腥味一冲上来，我追得更紧
lines.en: The smell of blood drives my pursuit harder
Don't count on me stopping

lines.zh: 平原上多了一道细长的影子
lines.en: A long thin shadow appears on the plain

lines.zh: 草分开，我直起脖子站起来
lines.en: The grass parts as I rise up on my legs

lines.zh: 一声短促尖锐的叫划开空气
lines.en: A short, sharp cry cuts the air

lines.zh: 我的头先出现，然后才是身体
lines.en: My head shows first, then the body
Grass blades still sway at my legs
I walk up over the horizon

lines.zh: 这里的猎物看起来不少
lines.en: The prey here looks plentiful
I stop and read all four directions
This ground suits me
My shadow sweeps over a flock
The wind pushes my feathers back

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，宣告这片平原
lines.en: I call once, claiming this plain

lines.zh: 我从远处跑来，扬起尘土
lines.en: I come running from afar, kicking dust

lines.zh: 我的眼睛已经找到了活动的东西
lines.en: My eyes have already found movement
I land and a patch of grass goes flat

lines.zh: 脖子伸长了，我在数你们
lines.en: Neck out, I'm counting you

lines.zh: 今天这片平原归我巡视
lines.en: This plain is mine to patrol today
I don't hide; I never hide

lines.zh: 我的爪子在土上试了试
lines.en: I test the dirt with my claws
I look up to find the sun
My feathers catch fire and I flap wildly

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，腿折了一下
lines.en: I fall from a height and my leg buckles

lines.zh: 水呛进气管，我叫不出来
lines.en: Water floods my throat; I can't call
The blast throws me down into the grass
An arrow goes into my flank

lines.zh: 那股力量钻进骨头，我站不稳
lines.en: That force sinks into my bones; I can't stand straight

lines.zh: 很久没猎到东西，我腿都软了
lines.en: No kill for so long that my legs feel soft

lines.zh: 雷击落在我身上，我整只僵住
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and I lock up entirely

lines.zh: 脚下什么都没有了，我扑空
lines.en: Nothing underfoot; my claws find nothing
